inputs.share_count_basis: H1-2026 weighted-average DILUTED ADS (Q2 2026 6-K); held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the OpCo flows (charging both would double-count). Basic weighted 611.5m. Remaining $996m 2.375% converts kept at face in corporate debt AND the diluted count retained - a deliberate, mild double-charge (~$1.6/share) noted as conservatism.
inputs.net_debt_basis: SURPLUS corporate net cash only, NOT gross cash. Unrestricted cash $3,529.3m + short-term investments $5,569.6m (both 30-Jun-2026, Q2 2026 6-K EX-99.1, acc. 0001193125-26-344596) LESS $900m liquidity reserve backing Monee deposits payable ($4,285m x ~20%), LESS $1,100m escrow backing reserve (escrow payables + customer advances $3,329.8m vs restricted cash $2,461.5m at 30-Jun-2026 - filed shortfall is ~$868m; the $1,100m held is deliberate extra conservatism; restricted cash is already excluded from the cash line), LESS corporate debt $2,220.6m (borrowings $1,224m + convertible notes $996m). Deposits payable and escrow payables are NOT net debt (SOFI/Kaspi rule) - they are Monee operating funding, and the loan book they fund is valued inside the Monee segment model.
inputs.last_fcf_basis: OpCo (Shopee + Garena + corporate) FY2025 owner FCF, component-built: seg adj EBITDA $2,400m (Shopee 880.6 + Garena 1,700 - unallocated ~180) - allocated SBC $531m - D&A $421m = EBIT $1,448m; x(1-26%) = $1,071m NOPAT; + D&A - actual capex $513.8m + WC capture $377m. NOT reported_fcf - sbc - interest_income ($3,554.6m): that consolidated figure is distorted by Monee - its pre-provision earnings sit in OCF while the ~$3.8bn FY2025 loan-book build sits in INVESTING, so reported FCF overstates distributable group cash. Monee is carved out and valued separately on distributable earnings.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 20-F cash-flow add-back $625.0m (XBRL ShareBasedCompensation). No combined 'SBC incl. equity-award taxes' figure published; net-share-settlement withholding not separately tagged. Allocated 85% ($531m) to OpCo, 15% ($94m) to Monee, by headcount/revenue judgment. H1-2026 actual $293.8m (2.0% of revenue).
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 consolidated interest income excluded from the flows (the component build starts from segment adj EBITDA, which excludes it); its source asset - the surplus cash pile - is in the bridge instead, per the excluded-income/matching-asset rule. Interest earned on the ~$2.0bn ring-fenced reserves is stripped but the reserves are NOT in the bridge: deliberate conservatism.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 $14.5m + H1-2026 $416.8m actually spent under the $1bn Nov-2025 authorization. Flat count is a FUNDED convention here - buybacks are running at ~1.3x the SBC run-rate.
inputs.balance_sheet_date: 2026-06-30 (H1-2026 6-K, filed 2026-08-11); all bridge anchors incl. ST investments are 30-Jun-2026
inputs.wacc_rationale: OpCo WACC 11.5%, USD flows: rf 4.3% (US 10yr) + beta ~1.35 x ERP 4.5% = ~10.4%, + ~1.1pp blended EM country-risk/FX-translation premium (revenue earned in IDR/VND/THB/PHP/MYR/BRL/TWD, reported USD; a strong dollar mechanically compresses USD growth). Garena Free Fire single-title concentration and TikTok competitive risk are priced IN THE SCENARIOS, not stacked on WACC (charge risk once); WACC is identical across scenarios. Monee cost of equity 14.5%: rf 4.3% + 1.5 x 4.5% ERP = ~11.1% + ~2.4pp EM unsecured-consumer-credit premium (unseasoned book growing 62% YoY, deposit-funded, multi-jurisdiction rate-cap/regulatory exposure) + ~1pp for the off-Shopee/Brazil mix shift. Capitalized at CoE because distributable earnings are post-funding-cost; Monee's deposits are never in net debt.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP (ASC 842): operating lease cost is already fully inside opex/adj-EBITDA, so flows need NO adjustment and operating lease liabilities ($1,906m at 30-Jun-2026) are EXCLUDED from the debt bridge - including both would double-charge. Finance leases are immaterial ($45.4m at FY2025) and ignored.
inputs.notes: MODEL: sum-of-the-parts, per dcf-methods routing - Sea straddles two rows. (1) OpCo = Shopee + Garena + corporate: 10-year component owner-FCF DCF (owner-fcf.md), FY0 revenue $19,138m (group $22,938m less Monee $3,800m). (2) Monee: embedded EM consumer lender ($11.1bn principal outstanding at 30-Jun-2026, +62.5% YoY; funded by $4,285m deposits + $3,330m escrow) valued on DISTRIBUTABLE earnings = post-tax earnings less equity retained at 15% of loan-book growth, at 14.5% CoE - a lender's economics do not fit an FCF DCF: loan-book growth consumes cash but creates an earning asset (the FY2025 book build sits in investing activities while provisions are added back in OCF, so consolidated FCF misstates both parts). One blended DCF was rejected for exactly that reason. (3) Surplus corporate net cash added once, in the bridge. Credit-quality caveat: the stable ~1.0% 90-day NPL is weak evidence - the denominator is growing 62% YoY with unseasoned loans, and provisions (+68.5% YoY H1-2026, $1,021m) are outgrowing the book; the bear case makes this the central axis. NCI of $138.3m (~$0.22/share) not deducted - immaterial. FRESH BUILD - no prior SE DCF, no reconciliation block.

historical_growth.notes: EPS and owner-FCF CAGRs are null: FY2020-22 bases are negative (owner FCF FY2022 -$2,801m). Consolidated owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income): FY2023 $821.7m, FY2024 $1,877.6m, FY2025 $3,554.6m (2yr CAGR ~108% - base-effect, not a projection input, and inflated by the loan-book distortion described in last_fcf_basis). Equity CAGR (29.2%) exceeds revenue CAGR (22.6%) by 29% - below the 30% flag threshold, but note equity growth is inflated by $2.1bn of convertible-note conversions FY2024-25, not just retained earnings. Selected 22.6% is the screener's forward proxy only; the model itself uses an OpCo path fading 38% -> 4.5% anchored to H1-2026 actuals (+47.4% group) and FY2026 guidance (Shopee GMV ~25%, Shopee adj EBITDA >= $1bn).

base.narrative: Shopee holds ~55% share of a consolidating SE-Asia duopoly and keeps trading margin for growth exactly as guided: OpCo revenue +38% FY2026 (H1 actual +45%) fading to 4.5% by Y10, adj EBITDA margin dipping to 10.4% (Shopee ~$1.0bn + Garena ~$1.9bn - corporate) then maturing to 17% as ad take-rate and logistics density close the gap to MELI-like economics. Garena's Free Fire re-monetization holds but the title ages - no successor hit assumed. Monee book fades 42% -> 5% growth with ROA compressing 8.5% -> 5.0% as rate caps, competition and seasoning normalize today's unseasoned-book economics; 15% of book growth is retained as equity capital before anything is distributable.

bull.narrative: All three engines keep firing: TikTok Shop rationalizes subsidies, Shopee compounds GMV high-20s with ad monetization closing toward mature-peer take rates (margin to 19%), Garena lands durable IP-collaboration monetization, and Monee's credit quality holds as the book seasons (ROA fades only to 6.0%, book compounds faster into Brazil/Philippines). Terminal growth 3.5%.

bear.narrative: The two independent high-severity axes fire: (1) TikTok Shop (31% regional share, +66% GMV in 2025) reignites the subsidy war - Shopee take-rate gains reverse, OpCo margin stalls at 9.5-12.5% and growth fades to GDP by Y5; Garena's recovery proves promotion-driven and rolls over. (2) The Monee credit cycle arrives in 2027: the unseasoned 62%-growth book seasons badly (provisions already +68.5% YoY vs +62.5% book), ROA collapses to 3.5% before a partial rebuild to 4.0%, book growth is regulator/appetite-constrained to single digits. Indonesia withholding-tax and Brazil parcel-tax regimes bite. Terminal growth 2%, TV cap 15x.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear lifted to 25% from the house 15% default: two INDEPENDENT high-severity axes (a TikTok subsidy war and a Monee credit cycle on an unseasoned book growing 62% YoY with provisions outgrowing it) plus live regulatory wires in the two biggest growth markets (Indonesia withholding tax from Aug-2026, Brazil parcel-tax measure pending Sep-2026). Bull trimmed to 25% from 35%: the bull case needs several independent things right simultaneously - subsidy rationalization AND Garena durability AND benign credit seasoning.

The market is paying more than full credit for treating comp as non-cash - the premium over street is the growth-optionality the market grants beyond this model's fades.

sanity_check.trip_rules_applied: Generic rules (1.5x historical max P/B / P/E) are DISABLED for SE: loss-making until FY2023 so there is no meaningful P/E record, and the P/B / P/S history is dominated by the 2020-21 bubble (P/B max 27.8x, P/S max 21.7x FY2020) and the 2022 crash (P/S 2.3x) - a 1.5x-of-27.8x threshold would wave anything through. Applied instead: base-case IV must imply P/S and forward SBC-adjusted P/E inside or below the FY2023-25 POST-PROFITABILITY range (P/S 2.10-4.35; FY2025 SBC-adj P/E 85.4x, EV/adj-EBITDA 33.6x as the only earnings marks). FY2019-21 excluded as outlier years.

historical_multiples.excluded_reason: 2020-21 bubble maxima and pre-profitability record; earnings-multiple history (2 profitable years) is too short to be a constraint either way.

base_iv_implied.note: Base IV $95.82 = $60.8bn cap = 2.65x FY2025 revenue (inside the 2.10-4.35 post-profitability range) and ~27.3x FY2026E group owner earnings (~$2.2bn: OpCo NOPAT $1,134m + Monee $927m + ~$160m post-tax interest on the $4.88bn surplus) for a business growing revenue ~40%. Not tripped.

current_price_implied.note: The market's $78.2bn cap is also inside the FY2023-25 P/S range - the disagreement with our IV is about margin maturity, Monee capital consumption and SBC, not about a bubble multiple.

sanity_check.monee_cross_check: Monee base equity value $9,340m = ~10.1x FY2026E segment earnings (~$927m) - conservative vs fintech comps (Kaspi ~8-9x on a proven book, Nubank 20x+), deliberate given unseasoned-book risk; bull $13,349m (~13x), bear $4,334m (~6x through a credit cycle).
stale_anchors: Monee FY2025 year-end principal book estimated at $9.0bn (interpolated from $6.83bn Jun-2025 and $11.1bn Jun-2026 at the disclosed +62.5% YoY); Sea does not publish a clean Dec-2025 principal figure in the tagged data.
sanity_check.verdict: PASS - base and weighted IVs imply multiples inside the post-profitability range; no bubble-era anchor used.

valuation_philosophy.house_basis: SBC fully expensed (FY2025 $625m is ~40% of net income - treating it as non-cash would be the single largest overstatement available here), share count flat at 634.5m diluted, buybacks value-neutral (and currently funded at ~1.3x SBC run-rate). Street basis reported alongside; the price sits above even the street ceiling.
valuation_philosophy.why_sotp: One consolidated DCF was rejected because reported FCF ($4.5bn FY2025) is not owner cash: Monee's pre-provision earnings sit in OCF while the ~$3.8bn loan-book build sits in investing and its deposit funding in financing. An FCF DCF simultaneously OVERSTATES Monee (ignores the cash its growth consumes) and cannot price its credit risk. Shopee+Garena are valued on component-built owner FCF; Monee on distributable earnings (post-tax earnings less 15%-of-book-growth equity retention) at a 14.5% CoE; surplus corporate cash counted once, in the bridge, after ring-fencing deposit/escrow backing.
conservatisms: Only $5.7bn of the $9.9bn headline liquid assets credited as surplus
Interest on the $2.0bn ring-fenced reserves stripped without crediting the asset
Converts double-charged (face in debt AND shares in diluted count), ~$1.6/share
Monee terminal at ~9.4x distributable / implied ~10x earnings despite 25%+ growth at that point
Stable 1.0% NPL treated as weak evidence (unseasoned denominator), bear weight 25%
valuation_philosophy.what_would_change_the_call: Evidence that Shopee's mature adj-EBITDA margin exceeds ~17% of revenue (ad take-rate closing to MELI levels faster), or two more years of Monee vintage data showing provisions decelerating below book growth - either would move the base toward the bull's $140. A TikTok subsidy re-escalation or provision growth persistently >75% YoY moves weight toward the $45 bear.
